listing.title: OGANIKO Raw Spanish Mountain Honey 1 kg – Unpasteurised, Cold-Extracted, Unfiltered Dark Amber Honey from Hives Above 800 m
bullets: HIGH-ALTITUDE ORIGIN – from hives above 800 metres in Spain's mountain ranges.
RAW AND UNFILTERED – cold-extracted and gravity-filtered, never pasteurised.
DARK AMBER TASTE – smooth and full-bodied, with caramel, malt and nutty notes.
HARVESTED LATE – July to September, with half the honey left for the bees.
1 KG GLASS JAR – naturally runny; slow crystallisation is a sign it's raw.
listing.note: No health claims: for food sold in the EU, only approved health claims are allowed.

items.q: Can you make my listing rank first?
items.a: Nobody can promise that. I write for the buyer and place the search terms where Amazon reads them, which is what you control.

items.q: Can you help me choose what to sell?
items.a: Yes. Product research looks at the niche, the competition and the buyers before you commit to stock or listings.

items.q: Do you make the images too?
items.a: Yes: the brief, the art direction and the finished image set, including the A+ modules.
Amazon UK, Germany, France and Poland. I write in English, German and French; Polish is checked by a native speaker.

items.q: What about health or performance claims?
items.a: I keep copy to what you can prove and what the rules allow. For food in the EU, only approved health claims can be used.
